prompt_text: Donor CRM with online giving forms
response_text:
**DonorPerfect** is a leading Donor CRM with integrated online giving forms that automatically sync donations to donor records, support recurring gifts and tributes, and boost completion rates up to 3x the nonprofit average.[1][2]

### Key Features of DonorPerfect Online Forms
- **Customizable design**: Use a drag-and-drop builder to add fields, branding, checkboxes, dropdowns, and text inputs that map directly to your CRM.[2]
- **Seamless integration**: Gifts sync automatically to DonorPerfect for real-time acknowledgments, reporting, and personalized thank-yous; staff get email notifications.[1][2][6]
- **Enhanced giving options**: Include monthly upgrades, suggested amounts based on donor history, digital wallets, DAFpay, and donor-covered transaction fees.[2][6]
- **Embedding and accessibility**: Easily embed on websites or emails; supports international donors with fast, secure checkout.[2]

### Other Donor CRMs with Online Giving Forms
Several alternatives offer similar functionality, often with matching gift integrations via Double the Donation:

| CRM | Online Giving Forms Highlights | Source |
|-----|-------------------------------|--------|
| **Virtuous** | Customizable forms/pages with data intelligence to optimize gift amounts and donor experiences.[4] | [4] |
| **Donorbox** | AI-powered CRM with free online donation buttons and comprehensive fundraising tools.[5] | [5] |
| **Givecloud** | Forms with smart suggested amounts, social proof, and modern payments to convert one-time givers.[7] | [7] |
| **DonorDock** | Fully embeddable forms for seamless website integration and easy donating.[10] | [10] |
| **Funraise** | High-performing forms integrated with matching gifts; automates follow-ups at donation time.[3] | [3] |
| **Givebutter** | Collects employment data during donations for automated matching gift emails.[3] | [3] |

**Giveffect**, **Bloomerang**, **Keela**, **Neon CRM**, and others like DonorDirect also provide donor management with online forms and matching gift tools, but details emphasize integrations over form customization.[3][8][9]

For setup, DonorPerfect offers video guides covering payment gateways, code options, and automatic gift downloads.[6] Choose based on needs like AI features (Donorbox, Virtuous) or embedding ease (DonorDock).[1-10]
